articles.title: Mass Schedule & Parish Information
articles.introtext:
Mass Schedule & Parish Information

Weekend Mass

Saturday: 5:30 PM (Vigil Mass)
Sunday: 7:30 AM, 9:00 AM, 11:00 AM

Weekday Mass

Monday: 7:30 AM, 5:30 PM
Tuesday: 7:30 AM
Wednesday: 7:30 AM
Thursday: 7:30 AM
Friday: 7:30 AM, 5:30 PM
Saturday: 7:30 AM

Confession Times

Monday - Saturday: 7:00 AM to 7:25 AM
Monday - Friday: 5:00 PM to 5:25 PM
Saturday: 4:00 PM to 5:00 PM
Confessions are also heard during weekend Masses

Perpetual Adoration Times

The Blessed Sacrament is exposed 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. Those wishing to occasionally adore may enter through the church during normal operating hours. Those whishing to have a regularly scheduled hour can contact the parish office.

Office Hours

Monday - Friday: 8am - 4pm
Phone: 316-425-0595
Fax: 316-425-0685

Prayer Requests

Email: sienaprayerchain@gmail.com

All Parishioners

Please keep us informed of changes in names, addresses, phone numbers, etc. to update our files.

Vocations from our Parish
articles.introtext:
Vocations from our Parish

{loadmoduleid 191}

Heavenly Father, bless our diocese with the grace of many vocations to the priesthood and religious life. Through the intercession of the Blessed Mother, grant to those You have called the willingness and generosity of spirit to give themselves in devoting their lives and their talents to the service of our Lord and to His Church. Increase the faith of all within our diocese and particularly the faith of those You have called to continue the call. We ask this through Christ, Your Son. Amen

Pray for Our Seminarians
